summary.fr: Sur le patch 16.22, Heimerdinger support affiche 49,3 % de victoires sur 1 045 parties classées (Émeraude+), tier D. Il souffre surtout contre Nautilus, Leona et Thresh.
summary.en: On patch 16.22, Heimerdinger support has a 49.3% win rate over 1,045 ranked games (Emerald+), D tier. It struggles most against Nautilus, Leona and Thresh.
